player_prompt.intro:
You are solving the Sokoban puzzle. You are the player and you need to push all boxes to targets.
        When you are right next to a box, you can push it by moving in the same direction.
        You cannot push a box through a wall, and you cannot pull a box.
        On the board, objects are represented as: 
        - The player (you) appears as 'P' 
        - Walls are represented with '#' 
        - Boxes are marked as 'X' 
        - Empty goals are shown with a 'O'
        - Boxes on goals are visualized with '√'
        You can also use [w] for up, [a] for left, [s] for down, and [d] for right.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Gerakan nan dikirimkan indak mangikuti format nan bennar. Gunakan [up], [down], [left], [right] atau [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: Panggerak nan diajukan indak adolah tindakan sah.
invalid_move.wall_collision: Awak indak buliah pindah ka dalam tembok!
invalid_move.invalid_position: Langkah indak sah - indak dapek mamindah ka posisi tu.

outcome.win: Tahniah! Awak lah manyalasaikan teka-teki Sokoban!
outcome.turn_limit: Bateh giliran lah digunoan. Awak alun manyalasaian teka-teki tu.
